title: Blessed Virgin Mary
subtitle: Optional Memorial (Saturday of BVM) · Phil 4:10-19; Lk 16:9-15
text: On Saturdays in Ordinary Time when no memorial binds, the Church may keep a memorial of the Blessed Virgin Mary—she who kept faith on the great Saturday while the Lord lay in the tomb. Today’s Gospel also warns that no one can serve two masters: you cannot serve God and mammon. Ask Our Lady to keep your heart fixed on the one Master who is enough.
